svg.title: How alpheus ui should look, as a pencil sketch
svg.desc: A pencil sketch of the alpheus ui, a page the CLI serves on localhost. Window 1, Runs: a namespace selector, filters for all, running and failed, and a table of runs with phase, steps finished, start and reason, where the failed run sales stands out. Window 2, Run sales: Failed with reason ComponentFailed and the message, the flow drawn as boxes generate, filter with two replicas, one crossed out, and count, with chunks and lag on the arrows, a table of replicas with phase, attempt, reason and message, and the run's events. Window 3, filter replica 1: tabs for counts, error log, logs and failures; the logs of attempt 4 show debug lines and the error, kept in S3, and a button Replay attempt 4 that runs alpheus replay on the chunks the attempt had open. Notes say the page is live, read-only with your kubeconfig, and part of the CLI binary.

g.text: alpheus ui — how it should look
$ alpheus ui → opens localhost:7171 in your browser
step filter replica 1 failed after 3 restarts: the component exited with code 1:
chunk 7 (source chunk 13) is one this component cannot handle
10:04 ComponentFailed filter replica 1 attempt 1 failed, restarting (1 of 3)
10:09 ComponentFailed filter replica 1 attempt 4 failed after 3 restarts
chunk 13) is one this component cannot handle","exit_code":1}
kept in S3 when the attempt failed, so the pod can be gone
the same image, on the 2 chunks it had open, at debug level
Error log: code, message and input chunk of each entry, from results/…/_errors/
Counts: exact, committed numbers per unit, and the live metrics next to them
one page in the CLI binary:
Go and plain HTML, nothing to install
